description: This PHP source file defines the class SugarWidgetSubPanelTopComposeEmailButton, a widget for rendering a 'Compose Email' button in a sub-panel within the SuiteCRM application. It extends SugarWidgetSubPanelTopButton and includes methods for generating the button's HTML, retrieving widget IDs, and handling access permissions.

classes.name: SugarWidgetSubPanelTopComposeEmailButton
classes.description: A widget class for rendering a 'Compose Email' button in sub-panels within SuiteCRM, handling permissions and email client integration.

methods.name: getWidgetId
methods.description: Returns the unique ID for the widget, optionally with a suffix.

methods.name: _get_form
methods.description: Generates the HTML form/button for composing an email, considering user permissions and email client.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Renders the widget button if the user has edit permissions.
